title: Observability and alerting
subtitle: SMS alerting is wired to the service fleet, with a metrics stack and dashboards beside it, and a status dashboard that says plainly what each service is doing.

stats.label: scrape jobs across hosts, GPUs and inference nodes
tokens between received and routed after the accounting fix

lede: Auth and access plane holds the observability layer for an estate one person operates, and that shaped every choice: nothing may depend on someone watching a dashboard. My Rust services expose native metrics endpoints, and a containerised Prometheus scrapes them, covering hosts, GPUs and inference nodes. I wired discovery to provisioning. When the execution substrate stands up a GPU node, locally, on a LAN workstation or on rented cloud capacity, it writes the node into Prometheus's file-based service discovery and installs the host and GPU exporters on it, so a new node is monitored from its first minute with no one editing a scrape configuration.
quote: I instrument systems as I build them and treat the instrumentation as part of the product.
evidence: Observability and alerting: Prometheus, Alertmanager and Grafana for an estate one person operates, 12 scrape jobs across hosts, GPUs and inference nodes, alerts paged to a phone by severity.
Monitoring wired to provisioning: GPU nodes written into Prometheus file-based discovery with exporters installed as they are stood up, locally, on a LAN or in the cloud.
Dashboards for GPU economics: Inference Fabric panels for padding waste, cache hit rate and tokens received against routed, the panel that showed 12.3B received and 12.3B routed.
Cost attribution for AI work: AgentOS dashboards of cost and usage per role and per model, read from the governance database.
author: Corey James
